CHAPTER 3 · ITEM 04 / 08

Absolute and comparative advantage

Specialization & combined PPF分工與整體 PPF

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Determine each producer's efficient specialization and exports. Construct the combined PPF by assigning production to those with the lowest opportunity cost first.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

增加某商品時先用機會成本最低的生產者。各方出口有比較優勢的商品；當第一位已完全專門化，再轉第二位，整體 PPF 斜率改變。

Assign extra production first to the lowest opportunity-cost producer. Each exports the good with comparative advantage. Combining their production possibilities can generate a kink where the first producer becomes fully specialized.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A: 10 X or 20 Y; B: 6 X or 6 Y. Both all-Y gives (0,26); B switches fully to X gives (6,20); both all-X gives (16,0). 邊界依次經過三點。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

In this example, the efficient specialized output with A all-Y and B all-X is? 分工後產量？
